title: The tollman's tick health (tick-health.json)
description: The failing streak of the tollman's timer rounds (hal2 plan 0530 D4; the farmer skill's scripts/tick_health.py, called by role_cli.run_tick): rewritten by every round that is not a dry run, through a temp file and a rename. The 2nd failed round in a row sends one desktop notice and puts a line at the top of summaries/latest.md; a good round resets it.

at.description: The last round's time, RFC 3339 UTC with Z and whole seconds.

failures.description: The failed rounds in a row; 0 after a good round.

error.description: The last failure's line `<Type>: <message>`; empty after a good round.

notified.description: Whether this streak's one notice went out.
